user_direction_source: 适用于普通人快速对一篇论文的核心研究进行提取，验证以及快速修改
interpreted_direction: Help non-expert researchers and agent builders extract, verify, adapt, and re-validate a paper's core research workflow while preserving its evidence boundaries.
research_problem: Existing paper-to-agent and knowledge-to-skill systems can package procedures, but ordinary source links do not establish which paper evidence supports each operational instruction or whether a later adaptation remains valid.

target_users.primary: Users with basic task or domain context who are not experts in the paper's specific method.
target_users.excluded_claim: The project does not assume that a user with no domain background can safely redesign arbitrary scientific methods.

claimed_novelty_normalized: Paper-specific epistemic grounding that aligns claims, method actions, assumptions, validation evidence, and failure boundaries, then propagates the effect of typed user edits into explicit re-validation requirements.
required_capabilities: extract a claim-method-assumption-evidence representation from a paper
label content as supported, inferred, conflicted, or missing
keep original evidence immutable while recording editable adaptations separately
classify adaptation deltas and identify invalidated claims or assumptions
produce concrete re-validation requirements after an edit
claim_boundaries: Do not call the system portable without matched cross-harness evidence.
Do not claim robust arbitrary-PDF understanding from a smoke path.
Do not treat line-span validity as semantic evidence entailment.
Do not use hidden curated notes as an unmeasured treatment in the main evaluation.
Do not describe adaptations as changes to the original paper's facts or results.

closest_adjacent_leads.title: Anything2Skill: Compiling External Knowledge into Reusable Skills for Agents
Paper2Agent: Reimagining Research Papers As Interactive and Reliable AI Agents
SkCC: Portable and Secure Skill Compilation for Cross-Framework LLM Agents
SkillWiki: A Living Knowledge Infrastructure for Agent Skills

preliminary_falsification_seed: On held-out papers and matched information budgets, removing edit-time epistemic re-validation should cause post-edit unsupported-instruction rate to return toward a source-map-only baseline while downstream adaptation correctness also declines.
resource_constraints: Reuse current local artifacts before commissioning new experiments.
Do not install dependencies or modify environments without user approval.
Treat external provider failures as availability evidence, not model-quality evidence.
